design_decisions.decision: Round 2 = the served-option space that answers G16, scoped to the five R2 lanes
design_decisions.why: G16 is the only open gap whose named closure is 'run the documented options', and R2-A..R2-E were commissioned against exactly that. C63 (the 2x2) is already measured, so Round 2 must not rerun it.

design_decisions.decision: Deliverable written to docs/serving-options/R2-DESIGN.md, not papers/**
design_decisions.why: This unit is not licensed to edit the manuscript; the design is a serving document and sits beside MATRIX-2x2.md (the Round-1 answer) and the five R-*.md lane notes.

design_decisions.decision: Predictions pre-registered with a stated falsifier each (P1..P9), and a null is reported as a result
design_decisions.why: Without a pre-committed direction, arms chosen after seeing data cannot distinguish a documented-but-useless option from an untested one - which is the exact failure G16 records.

design_decisions.decision: P9 (no SGLang arm reaches V1's dense 2,230.7782 within +-10%) is named load-bearing
design_decisions.why: It is the only prediction that tests whether C63's engine effect is a property of the ENGINE or of the CONFIGURATIONS Round 1 picked. If any SGLang arm closes the gap, C63 becomes configuration-conditional and must be restated.

design_decisions.decision: --enable-mamba-shared-prefix-checkpoint recorded as absent-by-version, not as an arm
design_decisions.why: Absent from v0.27.1 (both bisects agree) so it would fail at argument parsing; and R2-D documents it requires EAGLE on the mamba group, which this box does not run - so even a version bump would not test it.

design_decisions.decision: HiCache (A6) included specifically as a re-test of a Round-1 rejection whose citation does not carry the claim
design_decisions.why: G16 records that LAUNCH-SGLANG.md:107-150 quotes 'ValueError: HiRadixCache only supports MHA and MLA yet' with no source URL of its own, and the string is absent from the cited thread for build 0.0.0.dev1+g4ccff141d; the live server already runs UnifiedRadixCache. Either outcome upgrades a citation into a measurement.
